{
  "format": 1,
  "rule": "req~inspector.screenshots~1",
  "example": "a window on a Retina display",
  "files": {"n.md": "# Notebook\nSome text.\n"},
  "steps": [
    {"line": "* Given the window's content is 800 by 600 points on a display with 2 pixels per point",
     "do": [{"launch": {"build": "debug", "inspector": true}},
            {"drive": ["menu", "File > Open…"]},
            {"drive": ["choose", {"file": "n.md"}]},
            {"inspect": ["wait"]},
            {"inspect": ["state"], "as": "given"}],
     "expect": [{"that": ".given.json.window.content | (.width | type) == \"number\" and (.height | type) == \"number\" and .width >= 100 and .height >= 50",
                 "why": "the window's content has a size in points, large enough to hold the rectangle asked for later"},
                {"that": ".given.json.window.scale | type == \"number\" and . >= 1",
                 "why": "the window is on a display with a known number of pixels per point"}]},
    {"line": "* When an agent asks for a screenshot of the window",
     "do": [{"inspect": ["screenshot", {"out": "window.png"}], "as": "whole"}],
     "expect": [{"that": ".whole.exit == 0 and (.whole.json.width | type) == \"number\" and (.whole.json.height | type) == \"number\"",
                 "why": "the inspector answers the request with the image it wrote"}]},
    {"line": "* Then it gets an image of 1600 by 1200 pixels",
     "do": [],
     "expect": [{"that": ".whole.json.width == .given.json.window.content.width * .given.json.window.scale",
                 "why": "the image is as wide as the content's width in points times the display's pixels per point"},
                {"that": ".whole.json.height == .given.json.window.content.height * .given.json.window.scale",
                 "why": "the image is as tall as the content's height in points times the display's pixels per point"}]},
    {"line": "* And asking for the rectangle at 0,0 of 100 by 50 points gives an image of 200 by 100 pixels",
     "do": [{"inspect": ["screenshot", {"out": "rect.png"}, "--rect", "0,0,100,50"], "as": "crop"}],
     "expect": [{"that": ".crop.json.width == 100 * .given.json.window.scale",
                 "why": "the cropped image is 100 points wide at the display's pixels per point"},
                {"that": ".crop.json.height == 50 * .given.json.window.scale",
                 "why": "the cropped image is 50 points tall at the display's pixels per point"}]}
  ]
}
EOF
